title: bug: MOE_WRAPPER_IN_WORKTREE refuses the wrapper test harnesses when a worker runs them inside its task worktree
description: WT-13's guard (design §6.1) refuses any moe-agent.{sh,ps1} whose path is under <repo>/.worktrees/task-*. A worktree-mode worker that runs `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh` or `worktree-landing.sh` from W launches W's own wrapper copy ($ROOT_DIR = W), so every wrapper case prints MOE_WRAPPER_IN_WORKTREE and fails. Repro: after WT-13 lands, copy scripts/ into <repo>/.worktrees/task-x/ and run its postflight.sh. A harness-only opt-out, or a WT-19 ruling, is needed before wrapper tasks run in worktree mode.
